jobs.description: Software Engineer II UiPath Bengaluru East, Karnataka, India 23 hours ago Over 200 applicants See who UiPath has hired for this role Apply Join or sign in to find your next job Join to apply for the Software Engineer II role at UiPath Email or phone Password Show Forgot password? Sign in Sign in with Email or New to LinkedIn? Join now By clicking Continue to join or sign in, you agree to LinkedIn’s User Agreement , Privacy Policy , and Cookie Policy . Save Report this job Life at UiPath The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission Agents and automations are only as good as the data they can reach. Data Fabric is UiPath’s unified data layer: it models and stores business data, federates data from external enterprise systems without copying it, and makes it available wherever it’s needed across UiPath. We are looking for a Software Engineer II to build core parts of Data Fabric platform. Backend expertise is a must, and full stack experience is a plus. You will spend most of your time on services, APIs, and platform capabilities, and also contribute to the web experiences customers use. At UiPath, we are tackling exciting challenges at the intersection of AI and intelligent agents. If you want to be part of it, we’d love to hear from you. What You'll Do At UiPath Passion for Building Scalable Solutions: Demonstrated ability to produce robust, well-tested, high-quality code while adhering to best practices in software development. Monitor what you ship in production, debug cross-service issues, and help resolve incidents. Ownership and customer focus: Own your features from design to production, with guidance on larger designs. Keep the customer experience at the center of what you build. Drive AI innovation: Build platform capabilities that let AI agents and automations discover and use business data through Data Fabric. Backend and distributed systems: Design, build, and optimize scalable, secure services and APIs for the large-scale, multi-tenant Data Fabric platform, with a focus on performance, reliability, and high availability. Contribute to the user experience: Build and improve web UI in Angular or React with TypeScript, and connect it to the backend services you build. Team Collaboration: Work well in agile teams, contribute towards team alignment, and foster a collaborative environment where ideas and knowledge are freely exchanged. Use AI tools well: Use AI tools and coding agents for development (for example, code generation, testing, debugging, and documentation), while keeping a high engineering quality bar. Effective Communication Skills: Clearly articulate technical ideas, design decisions, and solutions to diverse audiences in both written and verbal formats while driving consensus. What You'll Bring To The Team Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 3 to 5 years of software engineering experience building backend or full stack production services. Strong skills in a backend language such as C# (.NET) or Java, and a willingness to learn new ones. A builder's mindset and a bias for action: you take initiative, turn ideas into working software quickly, and stay comfortable with ambiguity. Curiosity about how AI is reshaping software development and the systems we build. Solid grasp of object-oriented programming, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, multithreading, asynchronous programming, and system design basics. Experience with relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including schema design and query performance. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. Familiarity with CI/CD, agile development, and writing automated tests. Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with globally distributed teams. Nice to have Experience with front-end development using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with React or Angular. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other container technologies. Familiarity with GraphQL or data mesh architectures. Understanding of LLMs and the AI powered API automation. Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Azure Monitor. Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned. Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy. jobs.title: Tech Lead
jobs.description: Tech Lead WPP Gurgaon, Haryana, India 23 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who WPP has hired for this role Apply Join or sign in to find your next job Join to apply for the Tech Lead role at WPP Email or phone Password Show Forgot password? Sign in Sign in with Email or New to LinkedIn? Join now By clicking Continue to join or sign in, you agree to LinkedIn’s User Agreement , Privacy Policy , and Cookie Policy . Save Report this job WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise. Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. For more information, visit WPP.com. Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 11 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js or Python, including 5 years of architecture across multiple systems. 3 years of experience owning engineering standards adopted beyond your own team, and mentoring senior engineers. Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with engineering, product and business stakeholders in other regions. Backend language and craft. You are an expert in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, and a practitioner in the other. You set our backend and frontend coding patterns, framework choices and upgrade path, and you are a practitioner in at least two other crafts. React and frontend. You set our full-stack conventions across teams: where logic lives, how APIs serve user interfaces, and how shared components are built and maintained. APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI from first principles: resource modelling, HTTP semantics, pagination, consistent error formats, versioning, idempotency and rate limiting. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and how to evolve both without breaking consumers. You set our API and serialisation standards and decide on exceptions. Data. You are fluent in PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions and zero-downtime migrations with Prisma, TypeORM or SQLAlchemy. You design DynamoDB and MongoDB models around access patterns, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload. You own our data-architecture standards, including how datastores are introduced and retired. Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design event-driven systems on queues and streams such as SQS, Kafka and BullMQ or Celery, using retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent consumers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You know the outbox and saga patterns and when orchestration is better than choreography. You own our reference architecture for reliability. Cloud and platform. You have built and run production services on AWS or GCP, both as Lambda functions and as Kubernetes workloads, and you understand the trade-offs between them: cold starts, concurrency, cost, capacity and deployment risk. You define infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK and release safely with canary and blue/green deployments. With Platform Engineering, you decide when we use serverless and when we use Kubernetes, and you set the reference architectures for both. Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and expect every team to do the same. You build balanced test suites: unit tests with Jest, Vitest or pytest, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests with Pact, and Playwright end-to-end tests that gate releases. You set our quality standard and approve any exceptions to it. Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry and use Datadog and CloudWatch to find problems before users do. You profile with flame graphs, measure p95 and p99 latency, and fix causes rather than symptoms. You set our standards for SLOs, dashboards, alerting and performance budgets, and you lead the hardest incidents to their root cause. Security and identity. You write secure code by default and apply the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 in practice. You design authentication and authorisation with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, secure service-to-service traffic with mTLS and workload identity, and integrate identity providers such as Okta, Keycloak and Cognito. You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once. Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional. AI-first engineering and LLMs. You use Claude Code every day and understand how large language models work: tokens, context windows, cost, structured output, embeddings and retrieval. You have built production features with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, including tool calling and evaluations, and designed agentic services with clear guardrails and human review. You set our AI-first operating model, covering approved models and frameworks, Claude Code conventions, evaluation and release gates, and governance. Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing and in conversation, and you adapt your message for engineers, product leaders and executives. You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions. Leadership and behaviours. You lead without authority and influence engineering heads and teams across the organisation. You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria. You mentor senior engineers into technical leaders, build an engineering practice that does not depend on you, and hold the bar under commercial pressure. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do. Preferred qualifications: B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. Experience maintaining a widely used open-source library. Experience with multi-region and disaster-recovery architecture. Experience mapping engineering controls to SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Experience with multi-agent systems and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK. Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme. Experience in the second backend language. About the job: WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Principal Engineer you own architecture and engineering standards for full-stack engineering across teams. You stay hands-on and set the bar for hiring. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on. Responsibilities: Own the architecture of TypeScript and Node.js or Python systems across multiple teams, and set the technical roadmap that takes them from where they are today to where the platform needs to be. Stay hands-on: write, review and ship production code, lead by example on test-driven development, profiling and AI-first delivery, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself. Set and maintain our engineering standards for API design, data, reliability, security, observability and testing; publish them as a style guide and reference architectures, certify teams against them, and decide on exceptions. Review designs and architecture decision records across teams, challenge assumptions, and make sure decisions are made on evidence and recorded with their trade-offs. Decide, with Platform Engineering, how we use AWS Lambda and Kubernetes, and own the cost, capacity and reliability consequences of those choices. Lead the response to the most serious production incidents and performance problems, find the root cause and make sure it does not happen again. Drive large-scale change such as migrations, framework upgrades and deprecations across many codebases through to completion, including switching off what has been replaced. Define how we build with AI: the models, SDKs and agentic frameworks we use, how Claude Code is used day to day, and how AI-written code and AI features are evaluated and released. Work with product, engineering and business leaders in other regions to shape what we build, turn business goals into technical plans, and make trade-offs visible. Set the hiring bar for full-stack engineers at every level, write interview material, calibrate interviewers and give recruiters clear screening criteria. Mentor senior engineers, grow the next generation of technical leaders, and build a community of practice through reviews, talks and knowledge sharing. Who you are: You're open : We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working. You're optimistic : We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected. You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day. What we'll give you: Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work. Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry. Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide. Technical Software Engineering Lead -Lead Software Engineer II
jobs.description: Technical Software Engineering Lead -Lead Software Engineer II Deloitte Hyderabad, Telangana, India 16 minutes ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who Deloitte has hired for this role Apply Join or sign in to find your next job Join to apply for the Technical Software Engineering Lead -Lead Software Engineer II role at Deloitte Email or phone Password Show Forgot password? Sign in Sign in with Email or New to LinkedIn? Join now By clicking Continue to join or sign in, you agree to LinkedIn’s User Agreement , Privacy Policy , and Cookie Policy . Save Report this job Summary Position Summary Technical Software Engineering Lead - Manager Deloitte Consulting Products (USI) About The Role Level: Manager Are you an experienced Software Engineer who has led the development of world-class software or digital products? Are you looking for an opportunity to expand your scope and lead products used by some of the biggest and most influential businesses around the world? If the answer to these questions is yes, we would like to talk with you. Key Responsibilities We are looking for a Senior Engineering Lead who is not only an exceptional coder but also adept at high-level design and implementation. The ideal candidate will have over 10 years of collaborative development experience, with a proven track record of leading an 8–10-person team. This role involves debugging, performance design and optimization, and working on containerized solutions using Docker. Experience with FastAPI, Python, and React front-end is essential. Key Responsibilities: Lead and mentor an 8-10 person engineering team, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment. Own the architecture across UI, APIs, data, and cloud infrastructure — scalable, secure, resilient, observable Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code in Python and React. Set and enforce engineering standards: design reviews, ADRs, code review expectations, testing strategy, release readiness. Oversee the development and deployment of containerized solutions using Docker. Debug and resolve complex technical issues across the full stack. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project requirements and deliverables. Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards. Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends. Partner with Product Management and UX as a peer — challenge the “what,” not just deliver the “how.” Drive end-to-end execution: design, build, test, deploy, and run in production. Be accountable for how the product handles consumer data: privacy, retention, access, and compliance obligations including India’s DPDP Act. Communicate status, risk, and bad news early and clearly to stakeholders. The team ConvergeCONSUMER™ is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world’s largest professional services firm. Qualifications Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. 10+ years of professional experience in software development. Proven experience in leading and managing an engineering team. Strong proficiency in Python and experience with FastAPI. Solid experience with React for front-end development. Expertise in high-level design, implementation, and performance optimization. Authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, SSO, RBAC, least privilege), secure coding, and threat modeling. Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized solutions. Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and relational data modeling. Experience building and deploying applications on GCP; working knowledge of Azure or AWS. Experience with Apache Spark for large-scale data processing. Working knowledge of quality gates and enforcing code quality standards in the delivery pipeline. Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and leadership skills. Experience And Leadership 10+ years of end-to-end software development experience, including system design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. At least 2 years of demonstrated people management experience leading medium to large enterprise teams within a product-based organization is mandatory. Experience leading full-stack engineers with strong expertise across backend services and frontend web applications. Proven ability to independently drive end-to-end project execution, taking ownership of design, development, cross-team coordination, and delivery in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary development environment. Experience working in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment with globally distributed and diverse teams. Proven ability to collaborate with business and delivery teams, mentor engineers, and drive technical decisions from concept through production. Excellent verbal and written communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical teams. Architecture and Full-Stack Engineering Proven ability to design scalable, secure, resilient, and high-performance applications across user interfaces, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure. Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with FastAPI are required for backend development. Experience with microservices architecture, domain-driven design, and RESTful services using technologies such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, and Spring Boot. Experience with REST APIs, PostgreSQL, data modeling, and enterprise system integration patterns. Experience with NoSQL data stores such as DynamoDB and relational data stores such as MySQL and Oracle. Experience defining technical standards, conducting design reviews, evaluating technology choices, and ensuring adherence to engineering best practices. Security, Cloud, and Engineering Excellence Deep knowledge of security engineering and authentication and authorization frameworks, protocols, and design patterns, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, single sign-on (SSO), role-based access control (RBAC), and least-privilege access. Strong understanding of application security, threat modeling, secure coding, vulnerability management, observability, and performance optimization. Experience working in distributed, cloud-based environments such as AWS services, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Google Compute Engine (GCE), and Azure. Hands-on knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with CI/CD using Jenkins and engineering hygiene practices, including GitHub workflows, branching strategies, pull request reviews, code quality, collaboration, and release readiness. Experience with test automation and integration testing using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber, and Playwright. Experience with observability, monitoring, and tracing tools such as New Relic, Splunk, SignalFx, Kibana, and Grafana. AI-Enabled Development and Delivery , to accelerate development and learning. Experience delivering generative AI–based solutions or projects. Additional Skills and Project Experience Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Experience with database technologies (SQL). Understanding of Agile methodologies.
